After the power-down bit is cleared
global reset. According to the KSZ9031 documentation
least 1ms for the reset to finish.
If the chip is accessed during reset
write will be ignored. Depending on the system performance and MDIO bus
speed
column2: we may or may not run in to this issue.

column1: This bug was discovered on an iMX6QP system with KSZ9031 PHY and
attached PHY interrupt line. If IRQ was used
lost. In polling mode
column2: the link status update was always correct.

column1: The investigation showed
read returned 0xffff (while the chip was still in reset) and
corresponding write hit the chip _after_ reset and triggered (due to the
0xffff) another reset in an undocumented bit (register 0x1f
resulting in the next write being lost due to the new reset cycle.
This patch fixes the issue by adding a 1...2 ms sleep after the
genphy_resume().
